lead: Ali Khamenei was an Islamic jurist, born on 19 April 1939 in Mashhad.
He died on 28 February 2026 in Tehran at the age of 86.

He is associated with work such as An Outline of Islamic Thought in the Quran, Four main books of Biographical-Evaluation and A 250 Years Old Person and has held the office of Supreme Leader of Iran and Member of the Islamic Consultative Assembly.
Below you will find a verified overview of Ali Khamenei: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Ali Khamenei — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ali Khamenei was born on 19 April 1939 in Mashhad, and holds citizenship of Pahlavi Iran and Iran.
Public records name his father, Javad Khamenei and his mother, Khadija Mirdamadi. He is a sibling of Hadi Khamenei, Mohammad Khamenei and Badri Khamenei.
His listed education includes Qom Hawza, Najaf Seminary and Hawza ‘Ilmiyya Khorasan.
He is recorded as speaking Azerbaijani, Arabic and Persian.

sections.heading: Ali Khamenei — Career and Professional Work
paras: Ali Khamenei works primarily as an Islamic jurist, politician, translator, writer, poet and cleric.
Among the credits most often linked to Ali are An Outline of Islamic Thought in the Quran, Four main books of Biographical-Evaluation and A 250 Years Old Person.

He has held the following offices: Supreme Leader of Iran (1989–2026), Member of the Islamic Consultative Assembly (1980–1981), President of Iran (1981–1989), Commander-in-Chief of the Iranian Armed Forces (1989–2026), Chairman of the Expediency Discernment Council (1988–1989) and Member of the Assembly of Experts (1983–1989). He is affiliated with Combatant Clergy Association.
